description: Sustainable Urban Drainage System SUDS Register FCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Fingal County Council. This data set contains the Register of Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SUDs) completed in Fingal County Council Administrative area This database contains location and description information for Sustainable Urban Drainage Systems (SUDs) installed as per final drainage drawings referenced to planning applications granted by Fingal County Council 2022. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
